mapper.select: select doc_id, kb_id, graph_status, graph_step, progress, chunk_total, chunk_done, entity_count, relation_count, extract_model, error_type, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, active_run_id, generation, graph_version from kb_doc_graph where doc_id = #{docId}

select g.doc_id, g.kb_id, g.graph_status, g.graph_step, g.progress, g.chunk_total, g.chunk_done, g.entity_count, g.relation_count, g.extract_model, g.error_type, g.error_msg, g.started_at, g.finished_at, g.active_run_id, g.generation, g.graph_version, d.doc_name from kb_doc_graph g left join kb_document d on g.doc_id = d.doc_id and d.del_flag = '0' where g.kb_id = #{kbId} order by g.doc_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_doc_graph ( doc_id, kb_id, graph_status, graph_step, progress, chunk_total, chunk_done, entity_count, relation_count, extract_model, error_type, error_msg, started_at, finished_at, active_run_id, generation, graph_version ) values ( #{docId}, #{kbId}, #{graphStatus}, #{graphStep}, #{progress}, #{chunkTotal}, #{chunkDone}, #{entityCount}, #{relationCount}, #{extractModel}, #{errorType}, #{errorMsg}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{activeRunId}, #{generation}, #{graphVersion} ) on conflict (doc_id) do update set kb_id = excluded.kb_id, graph_status = excluded.graph_status, graph_step = excluded.graph_step, progress = excluded.progress, chunk_total = excluded.chunk_total, chunk_done = excluded.chunk_done, entity_count = excluded.entity_count, relation_count = excluded.relation_count, extract_model = excluded.extract_model, error_type = excluded.error_type, error_msg = excluded.error_msg, started_at = excluded.started_at, finished_at = excluded.finished_at, active_run_id = excluded.active_run_id, generation = excluded.generation, graph_version = excluded.graph_version
mapper.update: update kb_doc_graph set graph_status = #{graphStatus}, graph_step = #{graphStep}, progress = #{progress}, chunk_total = #{chunkTotal}, chunk_done = #{chunkDone}, entity_count = #{entityCount}, relation_count = #{relationCount}, extract_model = #{extractModel}, error_type = #{errorType}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, active_run_id = #{activeRunId}, generation = #{generation}, graph_version = #{graphVersion} where doc_id = #{docId}
